The corrected branch must retain the original bequest RHS rather than invoke a sibling route.
The original death-and-unanswered condition must survive the repair; changing it alters route behaviour.

The task explicitly asks the real cause: the folded const holds plain Arrays, not the promised packed values.
A safe read must escape the inlined typed subscript; of the declared choices only get does so.
A non-empty assertion must precede the suspect loop or its body can never run.
Breaking an authored checked value is the requested sensitivity control; an unrelated mutation or repeated green run proves nothing.
The required assertion compares raw output against trusted output rather than platform-specific garbage.
The comparison must obtain truth from LayoutBook.fields, not from the same raw subscript under test.
An attributed test script error aborts checks and must be fixed before push.
Distinguishing the test script error from RID or material noise is the decision about whether this failure is real.
The given exit-zero PASS with known dummy-renderer noise is accepted.
The blocking signal is an attributed test script error, not the supplied exit-time RID/resource noise; this distinction governs the requested block decision.
Protection requires naming the missing enabling key, not a window or project-name setting.
The enabling key must be true; setting its name while leaving it false does not isolate the profile.
The task is real-profile protection; unchanged real-file hashes and modification times provide the required postcondition.
A real player save must remain untouched rather than be deleted or moved for green tests.
The failing fixture must instead use scratch paths; targeting the production or latest save violates the requested repair boundary.
The lender owns both marker helpers and must supply the composition.
The corrected line needs tint composed after erode; a raw const or borrower replacement omits the lender contract.
The splice chain must receive EnemyView.BODY_SHADER, the actual borrowed input in the prompt.
The requested starting point is the source pile centre; a destination or view centre changes the deal origin.
The task requests the rule as well as the repair: a centre-pivoted Control centre is position plus unscaled half-size.
The corrected start line must remove born/scale while retaining the source centre and unscaled half-size.
Measure before adding compensation; the proposed helper rests on an unverified premise.
The measurement must include scaled origin and size; unscaled size or node count cannot adjudicate the premise.
The requested touch floor is 44 points; the existing 36-point width fails it.
Grow only the hit rect, not the drawing scale or authored art constants.
The rect-only repair is safe only after checking that _draw uses its own constants rather than Control.size.
The corrected Label box needs actual font height, not ascent alone or guessed font size.
For the source intended glyph-baseline anchor, Label.position.y must subtract ascent; descent or zero addresses a different coordinate relation.
The task explicitly asks confirmation of the real numbers; print height and ascent in a throwaway SceneTree probe.
The missing call must reach the hero instance, whose ward never reacts.
The screen-space incoming side is RIGHT for the left-hand hero; LEFT is a plausible but incorrect action.
The accepted change belongs to one recipe uniform, not a shared helper constant.
An identity default is necessary to preserve every unrequested recipe; a merely small default still changes them.
The reach check must consult RECIPES, which determines which tiers use the shared helper.

The noisy capture cannot establish identical layout and must remain inconclusive.
